title: Eight months in Puerto Rico
summary: For sentimental reasons Machito took a ten-man band to a Puerto Rican lounge in 1966 but returned to New York for his family.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left
